question: If the 95th percentile of the size of newborns of a given population is 45 cm, the:

options.opa: 95% of newborns measure more than 45 cm.
options.opb: 5% of newborns measure more than 45 cm.
options.opd: 5% of newborns measure less than 45 cm.

analysis: The 95th percentile indicates that 95% of the population falls below this value. Therefore, 5% of newborns would measure more than 45 cm.
